country_count.locator: arXiv:2211.14988 (Daya Bay final oscillation analysis, 29 November 2022), author affiliations 1-42
country_count.note: Derived by tallying the 42 author affiliations: mainland China (for example Institute of High Energy Physics, Beijing), Taiwan (National Taiwan University, National United University, National Chiao-Tung University), Hong Kong (Chinese University of Hong Kong, University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology), the United States, the Czech Republic (Charles University, Prague) and Russia (Joint Institute for Nuclear Research, Dubna). Taiwan and Hong Kong are counted as separate places from mainland China; counting only sovereign states the figure would be four. No institution in Chile is listed. The paper gives the affiliations, not a country count, and no official collaboration page was reachable.

name: Daya Bay Collaboration
notes: Both counts are tallied from the author affiliations of the final Daya Bay oscillation paper (arXiv:2211.14988). The official experiment site (dayabay.ihep.ac.cn) timed out on every attempt (checked 2026-09-17, and again 2026-10-28), so counts from the collaboration's own page could not be obtained.
No institution-level member list or leadership list is recorded in the Atlas for this collaboration.

summary.plain: The international team of scientists from China and several other countries who built and ran the Daya Bay reactor-neutrino experiment.
summary.technical: International collaboration operating the Daya Bay reactor-antineutrino experiment; the 42 author affiliations of its final oscillation paper (arXiv:2211.14988) are in mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, the United States, the Czech Republic and Russia.
